_comment: Environment cube map for per-object IBL probes. faces are GL order: +X,-X,+Y,-Y,+Z,-Z (right,left,top,bottom,front,back). Reference from a Mesh component with "cubemap": "assets/cubemaps/studio.json". diffuse = how much this env LIGHTS the model (irradiance); specular = how much it REFLECTS. Lower diffuse hands shading to the directional sun (less uniform). 1.0 = full; 0 = off.
